lines: Eleven panels, eleven masts, and I know the order the way you know your own name.
Two of them are dark. Fenn feathered them on Tuesday and she has never feathered one in eleven years.
She did not explain. She said the word FEATHER and went back out. That is the whole conversation.
Nothing on that board is labelled and nothing on it ever will be.
You learn it at nine, standing where you are standing, and then you know it for life.
A label is a thing you read. In here you do not have time to read.
Nine hundred turns on a mast coil, every one of them by hand, and you cannot hurry it.
This is number four this month. In March it was one. In March it is always one.
I am not going to say what that means. I just wind them. Somebody else can say it.
You went up and you came down with it. Right. I have been up four times.
Not four attempts. Four times up, and I turned round twice before I got to the top.
She has never once said anything about that. That is somehow much worse.
Do not look at the gorge on the gantries. Look at where the gantry stops.
It is a tile wide and it is completely safe and none of that helps, so use the trick.
The trick is: look at where you are going. It is the whole trick. It works.
You are going OUT there? In this?
Grandad says the Hall is the only building in Skyreach with its front door on the inside.
I do not know what that means. He laughed for ages.
